div.div: فِشْلٌ (O, K,) or ↓ فَشْلٌ , (S,) [but said to be] with kesr, (O, K,) A certain thing (S, K) of the apparatus of the [women's camel-vehicle called] هَوْدَج, (S,) which the woman puts beneath her in the هودج: (K:) or the curtain (سِتْر) of the هودج; as also ↓ مِفْشَلٌ . (IAar, O, K.) [See a description thereof in the latter sentence of the first paragraph.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
